answer: Each agent must stake a bonded deposit tied to a unique hardware root key, and every epoch it burns a small amount of that stake, like an ember consuming its fuel. Registering many identities multiplies the burn, so a sybil swarm pays linearly while honest single agents pay once. A violet reputation score, earned only through verified peer attestations, gates access to high-value tasks, and a jetty-style cooldown blocks rapid re-registration after a key is retired or flagged.
